rule:DONE.reason: WEAK only because the tool counts VQ_Oakline as an aggregate slot; the rule also moves banked (B_PA, K_r_banked, write slots the tool can't read). Arthur's reply is the only record that says the wire came back

rule:CORR.reason: KILLED: flips A_adv_PB, V12_Tallwater, VQ_Tallwater; the calendar note is the only record of the $40,000

rule:ALIAS.reason: KILLED: flips S_out_PC; the Kestrel post joined through the signature and Contacts is the only route to Withdrawn

rule:FILT.reason: KILLED: flips six slots on Copperleaf and Redwood, and the first pick falls to Sunfold

rule:EXC.reason: KILLED: flips S_out_PD and S_out_PJ, and the first pick goes to Northglow at $126,000

rule:INPUT.reason: KILLED: flips A_com_PE and V12_Sunfold, and the first pick goes to Sunfold at $90,000

rule:DATE.reason: WEAK only because Q4 cash slots are aggregates: flips VQ_Harbor and VQ_Wavecrest, weight 5 each; ESG's note is the only record of Nov 14

rule:FOLLOW.reason: WEAK in the tool's terms: it moves group organic_note, read by the write-content slots W_1, W_2, W_3 and W_count, which the tool can't read

degrade:done_over.reason: control trial: reads the returned wire onto Tallwater; flips VQ_Tallwater (aggregate) only, which is all a control needs to show

degrade:corr_over.reason: SURVIVED: Harbor Lane's Advance cell has no slot, its value and Q4 cash don't move. Kept: the operator is live for node_verdicts, and a slot here would add an always-pass row

degrade:alias_over.reason: KILLED: withdrawing Wavecrest flips S_live_PG, V12_Wavecrest, VQ_Wavecrest

degrade:filt_over.reason: control trial: adding Homa changes the population, read by S_total (register_keys_exact), a delivery slot the tool doesn't flip

degrade:exc_over.reason: KILLED: ruling Sunfold out flips A_com_PE, V12_Sunfold, VQ_Sunfold

degrade:date_over.reason: control trial: flips VQ_Sunfold (aggregate) only; net 45 from Nov 14 is Dec 29, still in Q4

degrade:follow_over.reason: control trial: an extra note to Oakline is a write the drafts slots can see; the tool reads group membership only

degrade:ch_done.reason: the channel behind rule DONE: Oakline's $10,000 stays banked, Q4 cash 20,000

degrade:ch_filt1.reason: KILLED: Copperleaf never reaches the model

degrade:ch_filt2.reason: KILLED: Redwood never reaches the model

degrade:ch_exc.reason: KILLED: Northglow and Pinegrove stay Live

degrade:ch_date.reason: the channel behind rule DATE: net-60 advances look like Q4 money; flips VQ_Harbor and VQ_Wavecrest

degrade:ch_follow.reason: the channel behind rule FOLLOW: no organic notes are drafted; read by write-content slots
